rules.title: Rename __fields__ to model_fields
rules.notes: Attribute renamed in Pydantic v2; must use model_fields instead of __fields__ to access model field definitions.

rules.title: Rename __private_attributes__ to __pydantic_private__
rules.notes: Attribute renamed in Pydantic v2; must use __pydantic_private__ instead of __private_attributes__ to access private attributes.

rules.title: Rename __validators__ to __pydantic_validator__
rules.notes: Attribute renamed in Pydantic v2; must use __pydantic_validator__ instead of __validators__ to access validator functions.

rules.title: Replace construct() with model_construct()
rules.notes: Method renamed in Pydantic v2; must call model_construct() instead of construct() for creating model instances without validation.

rules.title: Replace copy() with model_copy()
rules.notes: Method renamed in Pydantic v2; must call model_copy() instead of copy() for creating a copy of a model instance.

rules.title: Replace dict() with model_dump()
rules.notes: Method renamed in Pydantic v2; must call model_dump() instead of dict() to serialize the model to a dictionary.

rules.title: Replace json() with model_dump_json()
rules.notes: Method renamed in Pydantic v2; must call model_dump_json() instead of json() to serialize the model to a JSON string.

rules.title: Replace parse_obj() with model_validate()
rules.notes: Method renamed in Pydantic v2; must call model_validate() instead of parse_obj() to validate and create a model from a dictionary.

rules.title: Replace update_forward_refs() with model_rebuild()
rules.notes: Method renamed in Pydantic v2; must call model_rebuild() instead of update_forward_refs() to update forward references in the model.

rules.title: Replace parse_raw with model_validate_json()
rules.notes: Function renamed and moved in Pydantic v2; must use model_validate_json() instead of parse_raw() to validate and create a model from a JSON string.

rules.title: Replace parse_file with model_validate_file()
rules.notes: Function renamed and moved in Pydantic v2; must use model_validate_file() instead of parse_file() to validate and create a model from a file. [unverified: source page does not mention the API]

rules.title: Replace from_orm with model_validate(..., from_attributes=True)
rules.notes: Method renamed in Pydantic v2; must use model_validate() with from_attributes=True instead of from_orm() to create a model from an ORM object.

rules.title: Update equality behavior: no longer equal to dicts
rules.new_pattern: # Equality now only compares with other BaseModel instances
rules.notes: Equality semantics changed in Pydantic v2; models no longer compare equal to dicts, only to other BaseModel instances with matching field values, extra values, and private attributes.

rules.title: Replace __root__ field with RootModel
rules.notes: Root model implementation changed in Pydantic v2; must replace __root__ field usage with RootModel class for custom root models.

rules.title: Remove json_encoders config, use @field_serializer or @model_serializer
rules.notes: Config key json_encoders removed in Pydantic v2; must migrate serialization logic to @field_serializer or @model_serializer decorators.

rules.title: Replace allow_mutation config with frozen
rules.notes: Config key allow_mutation removed in Pydantic v2; must use frozen setting instead to control model mutability.

rules.title: Remove error_msg_templates config
rules.notes: Config key error_msg_templates removed in Pydantic v2; must remove or migrate error message handling logic.

rules.title: Remove fields config, use Annotated with Field
rules.notes: Config key fields removed in Pydantic v2; must use Annotated with Field instead for field configuration.

rules.title: Remove getter_dict config
rules.notes: Config key getter_dict removed in Pydantic v2; no longer needed as orm_mode implementation detail was removed.

rules.title: Rename allow_population_by_field_name to populate_by_name
rules.notes: Config key renamed in Pydantic v2; must use populate_by_name instead of allow_population_by_field_name.

rules.title: Rename anystr_lower to str_to_lower
rules.notes: Config key renamed in Pydantic v2; must use str_to_lower instead of anystr_lower.

rules.title: Rename anystr_strip_whitespace to str_strip_whitespace
rules.notes: Config key renamed in Pydantic v2; must use str_strip_whitespace instead of anystr_strip_whitespace.

rules.title: Rename anystr_upper to str_to_upper
rules.notes: Config key renamed in Pydantic v2; must use str_to_upper instead of anystr_upper.

rules.title: Rename keep_untouched to ignored_types
rules.notes: Config key renamed in Pydantic v2; must use ignored_types instead of keep_untouched.

rules.title: Rename max_anystr_length to str_max_length
rules.notes: Config key renamed in Pydantic v2; must use str_max_length instead of max_anystr_length.

rules.title: Rename min_anystr_length to str_min_length
rules.notes: Config key renamed in Pydantic v2; must use str_min_length instead of min_anystr_length.

rules.title: Rename orm_mode to from_attributes
rules.notes: Config key renamed in Pydantic v2; must use from_attributes instead of orm_mode for attribute loading from ORM objects.

rules.title: Rename schema_extra to json_schema_extra
rules.notes: Config key renamed in Pydantic v2; must use json_schema_extra instead of schema_extra for schema extensions.

rules.title: Rename validate_all to validate_default
rules.notes: Config key renamed in Pydantic v2; must use validate_default instead of validate_all for validation behavior.

rules.title: Replace @validator with @field_validator
rules.notes: Validator decorator renamed in Pydantic v2; must use @field_validator instead of @validator, with signature restricted to field-level validation.

rules.title: Replace @root_validator with @model_validator
rules.notes: Root validator decorator replaced in Pydantic v2; must use @model_validator instead of @root_validator for model-level validation.

rules.title: Move ValidationError import from pydantic.error_wrappers to pydantic
rules.notes: ValidationError class moved in Pydantic v2; must import from pydantic instead of pydantic.error_wrappers.

rules.title: Replace PyObject with ImportString
rules.notes: PyObject class removed in Pydantic v2; must use ImportString to parse string references to objects.
